content.rendered:
The SMS school office is closed for the summer and will reopen on Monday, August 15th.

Students new to Sherwood School District can find enrollment information by clicking here. The District Office will be accepting all student registration paperwork during the summer until August 15th. Drop off or mail to the Sherwood School District Office at 21920 SW Sherwood Blvd., Sherwood, OR 97140. Please call 503-825-5000 with questions.

The SMS Registration Open House will take place the 3rd week of August. Please watch here for more information. A letter will also be mailed home in August.

2022-23 Supply Lists:

  • English
  • Spanish
